@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem PNat.coe_prod {ι : Type*} (f : ι → ℕ+) (s : Finset ι) :
    ↑(∏ i ∈ s, f i) = (∏ i ∈ s, f i : ℕ) :=
  map_prod PNat.coeMonoidHom _ _

  Positive.addLeftMono

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Defs
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_lt_coe (n k : ℕ+) : (n : ℕ) < k ↔ n < k :=
  Iff.rfl

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.ADEInequality
theorem admissible_D' (n : ℕ+) : Admissible (D' n) :=
  Or.inr <| Or.inl ⟨n, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
/-- There are strictly fewer than `q^2` units, since `0` is not a unit. -/
nonrec theorem card_units_lt (w : 1 < q) : Fintype.card (X q)ˣ < q ^ 2 := by
  have : Fact (1 < (q : ℕ)) := ⟨w⟩
  convert card_units_lt (X q)
  rw [card_eq]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
@[simp]
theorem neg_snd (x : X q) : (-x).2 = -x.2 :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Prime
theorem eq_one_of_lt_two {n : ℕ+} : n < 2 → n = 1 := by
  intro h; apply le_antisymm; swap
  · apply PNat.one_le
  · exact PNat.lt_add_one_iff.1 h

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Basic
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem pow_coe (m : ℕ+) (n : ℕ) : ↑(m ^ n) = (m : ℕ) ^ n :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Interval
theorem Ico_eq_finset_subtype : Ico a b = (Ico (a : ℕ) b).subtype fun n : ℕ => 0 < n :=
  rfl

    a ∈ SolutionSet hk ↔
    (∃ P : Polynomial ℤ, P.Monic ∧ P.degree = k ∧
     (∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ+,
        P.eval ((a n) : ℤ) =
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, a ⟨n + i + 1, Nat.succ_pos _⟩) := by
  sorry
